article_title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision

tasks.prompt: What is the report mainly about?
options: The rescue of everyone aboard a cruise ship after a collision on the Mississippi
A new cruise route opening between Texas and Louisiana
A tanker completing a record journey through New Orleans
The construction of a larger paddlewheeler in 2015
tasks.correct_answer: The rescue of everyone aboard a cruise ship after a collision on the Mississippi
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בחילוץ כל הנוסעים ואנשי הצוות לאחר שספינת מכולות פגעה בספינת התענוגות American Heritage.

tasks.prompt: Which vessel struck the American Heritage?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ספינת המטען Atlantic Asphalt פגעה ב-American Heritage, שנשכבה לאחר מכן על צדה בנהר.

tasks.prompt: How many people from the cruise ship were taken to hospital?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שלושים ושניים אנשים פונו לבית חולים עם פציעות שאינן מסכנות חיים.

tasks.prompt: What does “listing” mean when the report says the vessel started listing?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר ימי listing פירושו נטייה של כלי השיט לצד אחד, לפני שהספינה התהפכה על צדה.

tasks.prompt: What possible cause did Coast Guard Captain Melanie Burnham mention?
options: Some type of loss of steering
Excess passengers on the upper deck
A storm that closed the river
tasks.correct_answer: Some type of loss of steering
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הגורם המדויק עדיין נחקר, אך הקפטן ציינה שנראה כי אירע אובדן כלשהו של יכולת ההיגוי.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “unaccounted for” mean?
options: Unable to pay for the cruise
Not yet located or confirmed safe
Not included in the ship's ticket price
tasks.correct_answer: Not yet located or confirmed safe
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unaccounted for מתאר אדם שמיקומו או מצבו עדיין אינם ידועים; במקרה הזה לא נותר אף אדם כזה.

tasks.prompt: Why did officials describe the outcome as a “miracle on the Mississippi”?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין מספר האנשים, מצב הספינה ותוצאת החילוץ.
expected_points: About 129 passengers plus crew were aboard
The ship took on water, listed and tipped onto its side
Everyone was accounted for despite the danger

tasks.prompt: Summarise the collision and the rescue response in chronological order.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את ההתנגשות, הידרדרות מצב הספינה, פינוי הנוסעים והשתתפות כוחות החילוץ.
expected_points: The Atlantic Asphalt struck the docked American Heritage
Calls came in at about 13:30 EST as the cruise ship took on water
Passengers began disembarking as the vessel listed and tipped onto its side
Tugboat operators, police, first responders and the Coast Guard helped
The river was closed for the search and everyone was accounted for

tasks.prompt: What details show that the collision was frightening even though no injuries were critical?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בתיאור עד הראייה ובהתנהגות האנשים על הספינה.
expected_points: The witness compared the sound of crushing steel to a war movie
He said the scene looked like something from the Titanic
Passengers and crew were hollering and crying
The ship was sinking and ended up on its side

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining which parts of the rescue appear to have prevented a worse outcome.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג לפחות שתי פעולות חילוץ ולהסביר כיצד תרמו לתוצאה.
expected_points: Passengers began leaving while the ship was listing
People nearby immediately tried to help passengers escape
Tugboat crews, police and first responders rushed to the scene
The Coast Guard supported local operations
Officials closed the river and conducted a search until everyone was accounted for
